# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through GitHub's private vulnerability
reporting for this repository when it is available. Include the affected URL,
steps to reproduce, the expected impact, and any suggested remediation.

Please do not open a public issue containing exploit details or sensitive data.
Reports will be acknowledged as soon as practical.

## Supported version

The version currently deployed at <https://koon-kiat.github.io/> is supported.
